title: Hibernate "No default constructor for entity" with Kotlin: open the entity classes with all-open
errorSample:
org.hibernate.InstantiationException: No default constructor for entity 'task.Payment'
    at app//org.hibernate.metamodel.internal.EntityInstantiatorPojoStandard.instantiate(EntityInstantiatorPojoStandard.java:94)
    at app//org.hibernate.persister.entity.AbstractEntityPersister.instantiate(AbstractEntityPersister.java:4300)
    at app//org.hibernate.internal.SessionImpl.instantiate(SessionImpl.java:1599)
    at app//org.hibernate.sql.results.graph.entity.internal.EntityInitializerImpl.instantiateEntity(EntityInitializerImpl.java:1430)
    at app//org.hibernate.sql.results.graph.entity.internal.EntityInitializerImpl.resolveEntityInstance(EntityInitializerImpl.java:1422)
    at app//org.hibernate.sql.results.graph.entity.internal.EntityInitializerImpl.resolveEntityInstance2(EntityInitializerImpl.java:1381)
    at app//org.hibernate.sql.results.graph.entity.internal.EntityInitializerImpl.resolveEntityInstance1(EntityInitializerImpl.java:1274)
    at app//org.hibernate.sql.results.graph.entity.internal.EntityInitializerImpl.resolveInstance(EntityInitializerImpl.java:1173)
    at app//org.hibernate.sql.results.graph.entity.internal.EntityInitializerImpl.resolveKey(EntityInitializerImpl.java:617)
symptom: Loading a Kotlin entity fails with JpaSystemException / InstantiationException "No default constructor for entity". Saving works.
cause: Kotlin classes are final, and Hibernate needs entity classes to be non-final so it can create the subclasses it uses to instantiate and populate entities.
fixSummary: Apply the kotlin("plugin.allopen") plugin with the same version as the Kotlin plugin and register the persistence annotations: allOpen { annotation("jakarta.persistence.Entity"); annotation("jakarta.persistence.Embeddable"); annotation("jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass") }. The entity classes become open and Hibernate can instantiate them.
